verses.eng: "And moreover the word which your power has spoken: 'Through you I have gotten a power for me which helped me,'--it is again the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'And thereafter came an light-power to me through you which saved me.'
"And the word which your power has spoken: 'You have set lamps on my right and on my left, so that no side of me may be without light,'--it
is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken:
'Your power shone on my right and on my left and surrounded me on all sides of me, so that no part of me was without light.'
"And the word which your power has spoken:
'You have overshadowed me with the shadow of your grace,'--it is again the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'And you have covered me with the light of the stream.'

"And the word which your power has spoken: I was relieved of the coats of skin,'--it is again the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'And they have purified me of all my evil matters, and I raised myself above them in your light.'

"And the word which your power has spoken through Shalamah: 'It is your right hand which has raised me up, and has taken the sickness from me,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'And it is your light-stream which has raised me up in your light and has taken from me the emanations of Self-willed which constrained me.' "And the word which your power has spoken: 'I have become powerful in your truth and purified in your righteousness,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'I have become powerful in your light and purified light in your stream.'

And the word which your power has spoken: 'My adversaries have withdrawn themselves from me,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'The emanations of Self-willed which constrained me, have withdrawn themselves from me.'
"And the word which your power has spoken through Shalamah: 'And I am justified in your
goodness, for your rest endures to all eternity,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'I am saved in your goodness; for you save every one.'
"This then, O my Adanay, is the whole solution of the repentance which Pistis Sophia has uttered, when she was saved out of the chaos and loosed from the bonds of the darkness."

It came to pass then when the First Mystery had heard Thaawam say these words, that he said to him: Well said, finely, Thaawam, blessed one. This is the solution of the song which Pistis Sophia has uttered."
And the First Mystery continued again and said to the disciples: "And Pistis Sophia continued and sang praises to me, saying:

Sophia sings another song of praise. "'1. I sing a song to you; through your commandment have you led me down out of the higher aeon which is above, and have led me up to the regions which are below. "'2. And again through your commandment you have saved me out of the regions which are below, and through you have you taken there the matter in my light-powers, and I have seen it. "'3. And you have scattered far from me the emanations of Self-willed which constrained me and were hostile to me, and have bestowed power on me to loose myself from the bonds of the emanations of Adamas. "'4. And you have smitten the basilisk with the seven heads and cast it out with my hands and have set me above its matter. You have destroyed it, so that its seed may not raise itself up from now on. "'5. And you Were with me, giving me power

in all this, and your light surrounded me in all regions, and through you have you made all the emanations of Self-willed powerless. "'6. For you have taken the power of their light from them and made straight my way to lead me out of the chaos. "'7. And you have removed me from the material darknesses and taken from them all my powers, from which the light had been taken. "'8. You have put into them purified light and to all my limbs, in which was no light, you have given purified light from the Light of the Height. "'9. And you have made straight the way for them [ sc. my limbs], and the light of your face has become for me life indestructible. "'10. You have led me forth above the chaos, the region of chaos and extermination, in order that all the matters in it which are in that region, might be unloosed and all my powers be renewed in your light, and your light be in them all. "'11. You have deposited the light of your stream in me and I am become purified light.'
"This again is the second song which Pistis Sophia has uttered. Who then has understood this repentance, let him come forward and speak it."

It came to pass then, when the First Mystery had finished saying these words, that Mathathayahaw came forward and said: "I have understood the solution of the song which Pistis Sophia has uttered. Now, therefore, give commandment to me, that I speak it in openness."
And the First Mystery answered and said: "I give commandment to you, Mathathayahaw, to
set forth the interpretation of the song which Pistis Sophia has uttered."
And Mathathayahaw answered and said: Concerning the interpretation of the song which Pistis Sophia has uttered, thus your light-power prophesied aforetime thereon through the Ode of Shalamah:

Mathathayahaw interprets the song of Sophia from the Odes of Shalamah. "'1. He who has led me down out of the higher regions which are above, has led me up out of the regions which are in the bottom below. "'2. Who has there taken those in the midst, he has taught me concerning them. "'3. Who has scattered my foes and my adversaries, he has bestowed power on me over the bonds, to unloose them. "'4. Who has smitten the serpent with the seven heads with my hands, he has set me up above its root, that I may extinguish its seed. "'5. And you were with me, helping me; in all regions your name surrounded me. "'6. Your right hand has destroyed the venom of the slanderer; your hand has cleared the way for your faithful. "'7. You have freed them out of the tombs and have removed them from the midst of the corpses. "'8. You have taken dead bones and have clothed them with a body and to them who stirred not, have you given the activity of life. "'9. Your way is become indestructibleness and your face [also]. "'10. You have led your aeon above decay, so that they all may be loosed and renewed and your light become an foundation for them all. "'11. You have piled your riches upon them and they have become a holy dwelling-place.'
"This then, my Adanay, is the solution of the song which Pistis Sophia has uttered. Hearken, therefore, that I may say it in openness.

"The word which your power has spoken through Shalamah: 'Who has led me down out of the higher regions which are above, he has also led me up out of the regions which are in the bottom below,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'I sing praises to you; through your commandment have you led me down out of this higher aeon which is above, and have led me to the regions below. And again through your commandment you have saved me and led me up out of the regions which are below.'

"And the word which your power has spoken through Shalamah: 'Who has there taken those in the midst and has taught me concerning them,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophis has spoken: 'And again through your commandment have you caused the matter in the midst of my power to be purified, and I have seen it.'

"And moreover the word which your power has spoken through Shalamah: 'Who has scattered my foes and my adversaries,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'You have scattered far from me all the emanations of Self-willed which constrained me and were hostile to me.'

"And the word which your power has spoken: 'Who has bestowed on me wisdom over the bonds, to unloose them,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'And he has bestowed on me wisdom to loose myself from the bonds of those emanations.'
"And the word which your power has spoken: Who has smitten the serpent with the seven

heads with my hands, he has set me up above its root, that I may extinguish its seed,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'And you have smitten the serpent with the seven heads through my hands and set me up above its matter. You have destroyed it, so that its seed may not raise itself up from now on.'
"And the word which your power has spoken: 'And you were with me, helping me,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'And you were with me, giving me power in all this.'
"And the word which your power has spoken: 'And your name surrounded me in all regions,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'And your light surrounded me in all their regions.'

"And the word which your power has spoken: 'And your right hand has destroyed the venom of the slanderers,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'And through you the emanations of Self-willed became powerless, for you have taken from them the light of their power.'
"And the word which your power has spoken:
Your hand has cleared the way for your faithful,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'You have made straight my way to lead the out of the chaos, because I have had faith in you.'

"And the word which your power has spoken: 'You have freed them out of the tombs and have removed them from the midst of the corpses,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'You have freed me out of the chaos and removed me out of the material darknesses, that is out of the dark emanations which are in the chaos, from which you have taken their light.'

"And the word which your power has spoken: 'You have taken dead bones and have clothed them with a body, and to them who stirred not, you have given activity of life,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'And you have taken all my powers in which was no light, and have bestowed on them within purified light, and to all my limbs, in which no light stirred, you have given light out of your Height.'
"And the word which your power has spoken:

Your way is become indestructibleness, and your face [also],'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'And you have made straight your way for me, and the light of your face has become for me life indestructible.'

"And the word which your power has spoken: 'You have led your aeon above decay, so that all might be loosed and renewed,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'You have led me, your power, up above the chaos and above decay, that all the matters in that region may be loosed and all my powers renewed in the Light.'

"And the word which your power has spoken: 'And your light has become] foundation for them all,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'And your light has been in them all.' "And the word which your light-power has spoken through Shalamah: 'You have put your riches over him, and he has become a holy dwelling-place,'--it is the word which Pistis Sophia has spoken: 'You have stayed the light of your stream over me, and I have become a purified light.'
